display.name: Cloudflare
display.blurb: Manage Cloudflare zones, DNS records, cache, Workers, Pages, and R2 via the REST v4 API — authenticated with a scoped API token brokered at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `cloudflare` to drive the Cloudflare REST v4 API from this session — manage zones, DNS records, cache, Workers, Pages, and R2. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects your scoped API token (Bearer) on every request to api.cloudflare.com; `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT run any login or set a real token.

Each subcommand needs the matching power on your profile; calls to a path your profile didn't grant are denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.

Identity / token check: `cloudflare whoami` (GET /user/tokens/verify — always allowed).
Zones: `cloudflare zones` (list, needs `zones:read`); `cloudflare zone <zone_id>` (get, `zones:read`); `cloudflare purge <zone_id>` (purge everything, `zones:write`).
DNS: `cloudflare dns <zone_id>` (list records, `dns:read`); `cloudflare dns-create <zone_id> <type> <name> <content> [proxied]` (`dns:write`); `cloudflare dns-delete <zone_id> <record_id>` (`dns:write`).
Accounts: `cloudflare accounts` (list, `accounts:read`).
Workers: `cloudflare workers <account_id>` (list scripts, `workers:read`). Pages: `cloudflare pages <account_id>` (list projects, `pages:read`). R2: `cloudflare r2 <account_id>` (list buckets, `r2:read`).
Generic passthrough: `cloudflare get <path> [field=value …]` (any GET, query params) and `cloudflare api <METHOD> <path> [json-body]` (e.g. `cloudflare api POST /zones/<id>/dns_records '{"type":"A","name":"x.example.com","content":"1.2.3.4"}'`). <path> is relative to /client/v4. Responses are JSON {"success":true|false,"result":…,"errors":[…]}.
